main:
Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup.
Produce ONE complete portrait mobile game battle screen, 720x1280 composition, fullscreen pixels only, no phone frame, no surrounding presentation labels.
INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the ONLY layout/edit target: the existing Jungle Law hex battle page. Images 2,3,4 are visual style references from Tata Adventure Team; use them for bold near-black outlines, shape language, saturated flat shading, humorous compact animal proportions, environment paint and UI material ONLY. Do NOT transfer their characters, zombies, monster icons, logo, names, rectangular grid, formation count, elemental wheel, new controls, auto/speed/back buttons or text into the target.
TASK: Create an exceptionally close stylistic match to references 2-4 while retaining image1's own playable screen and original animal identities (squirrel, rabbit, grey wolf, parrot, hippo, monkey). Make them large-headed, short-bodied original cartoon animals, expressive eyes, simple readable two-tone forms, confident dark contour lines 3-5px at 720px width, painted flat color with small highlights, neither pixel art nor 3D. Retain each corresponding animal's exact position and approximate on-screen bounding size. Existing castle/towers become matching compact original cartoon silhouettes, no elaborate invented props. Keep all battlefield unit/card meanings and controls.
STRUCTURE LOCK: keep the existing hex lattice, positions, scale and diamond viewport from image1. The camera can show edge-truncated map cells as the existing pannable map; do not clip HUD or essential details. Friendly hex regions become cool mint/teal grass, enemy hex regions become warm peach/coral earth, cream readable boundaries, quiet inset plane texture. Use fresh olive/emerald foliage and a few rounded dark outlined rocks only in existing outside-board cream/background areas, no plants over the hexes. Scene must feel like a brightly illustrated forest battle, not an ornate fantasy poster; scenery stays low contrast behind units. Keep castles at existing left/right edge positions; simplify.
UI LOCK at 720x1280 logical coordinates: three TOP rounded counters at x46 y18 w186 h44; x250 y18 w220 h44; x488 y18 w186 h44. Render dark blue-purple (#272D49) UI plates with bold near-black outer strokes, soft inset edge, clear white Chinese numerals. Left is a single gold round coin icon + '60' (no repeated resource name); center exact '黄金3星 VS 黄金3星'; right a light blue notched ticket icon + '10'. Pause button x610 y78 w62 h56, same hit area, navy purple panel with clear white pause bars. No other permanent HUD, no bottom tabs/card belt.
Bottom panel EXACT x26 y1132 w668 h118 stays two-line instruction panel. Rounded ivory-white inset panel, thick deep navy outline, subtle purple shadow base, comfortable padding. Verbatim Chinese text: '1V1 菱形战场 · 拖动查看地图' and '点击己方可连接地块购买；防御塔价格随本局购买次数递增。' Make whole second sentence fit in TWO lines if needed, never tiny or clipped, important Chinese legible at portrait screen scale. Existing locked adjacent sites keep icons and coin costs 50 / 100 / 250 where already present, dark outlined recognizable camp/building silhouettes, gold coin icon + cost. Selected/available outline golden-yellow; friendly/enemy heads have short outlined health bars with blue/orange fill and dark background. Avoid making health bars blend into tile color.
Visual match priorities: graphic dark contour, genuinely flat 2D comic game rendering, bright restrained local-color blocks, broad shapes, cheeky warm expressions, legible white heavy UI type, light simple squash-like animal silhouettes. Use source1 gameplay geometry but strong source2-4 visual finish. Not pastel cozy watercolor, not brown wood UI, not glossy 3D, no gradients everywhere, no neon effects. No explanatory annotations, no extra modal, no new information, no changes to click positions. This is a preview skin concept, never a game implementation.
